page.overview:
What is Sub-space?

Sub-space (a.k.a. hyperspace) was a series of planes

Sub-space was discovered by humans at some point after the reformation of the Weyland-Yutani Corporation. With their discovery, displacement drives (which had already existed for FTL travel) could be used to navigate said planes. Navigating sub-space was more complex than navigating the material universe, to the point that some considered the science to be "eldritch." Transiting from sub-space to real space required a period of deacceleration. Rapid deacceleration could be lethal to a ship's crew.

Sub-space transmission technology existed prior to the 2630s. In the late 27th century, the Thirteen were in the midst of developing technology to use sub-space as a transmission medium, allowing real-time communication across the Human Sphere. Enormous amounts of energy would be required for said communication to function. Weyland-Yutani (or at least the Thirteen) had access to this technology, but reserved it for themselves. Even sending a sub-space transmission not in real time required significant energy expenditure.

Due to the quirks of sub-space transmission, a ghosting effect followed the people who were communicating; an 'echo' of the movements as displayed via hologram. Real-time communication could be enacted at least as far as 500 light years.
